name: UFP Technologies, Inc.
summary: UFP Technologies, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, designs and manufactures solutions for medical devices, sterile packaging, and other engineered custom products in the United States. The company provides protective drapes for robotic surgery, patient handling and comfort, advanced wound care, infection prevention, disposables for surgical and endoscopic procedures, packaging for medical devices, orthopedic implants, components for cardiac implants, dispenser coils for catheters, and biopharma drug manufacturing.
